label: 10月7日
subtitle: 美股只靠科技股创新高 · 谷歌买下二十年核电

briefs.en: Wall Street's main index closed at another record on Tuesday, but the gains came almost entirely from a handful of large technology names.
briefs.cn: 周二美股主要指数再创收盘新高,但涨幅几乎全部来自少数几家大型科技公司。

briefs.en: Google signed a twenty-year deal to buy 890 megawatts of nuclear power, paying for upgrades that will squeeze more electricity out of eleven reactors already running.
briefs.cn: 谷歌签了一份二十年协议,购买 890 兆瓦核电,并出资升级 11 座已在运行的反应堆,让它们多发一些电。

briefs.en: The American trade gap widened to roughly $106 billion in August, the widest in more than a year, as imports of chips and computers kept climbing.
briefs.cn: 美国 8 月贸易逆差扩大到约 1,060 亿美元,为一年多来最大,原因是芯片和电脑进口持续增加。

briefs.en: Penguin Solutions raised its revenue forecast for the coming year to about $2.4 billion, well above the $2.1 billion it had pencilled in earlier.
briefs.cn: Penguin Solutions 把下一年的营收预期上调到约 24 亿美元,远高于此前暂定的 21 亿美元。

briefs.en: German factory orders fell 10.6% in August from the month before, though stripping out a few very large contracts leaves a decline of just 0.1%.
briefs.cn: 德国 8 月工厂订单比前一个月下降 10.6%,但剔除几笔超大额合同后,降幅只有 0.1%。

deep.title: A tech company buys twenty years of nuclear power
deep.titleCn: 一家科技公司买下二十年核电

sentences.en: Google has agreed to buy nuclear power from Constellation Energy for the next twenty years, in one of the largest deals yet between a technology company and a power producer.
sentences.cn: 谷歌同意在未来二十年向 Constellation Energy 购买核电,这是科技公司与电力生产商之间迄今最大的交易之一。

sentences.en: Under the agreement, Constellation will spend more than $4.3 billion upgrading eleven reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
sentences.cn: 根据协议,Constellation 将投入超过 43 亿美元,升级位于伊利诺伊、宾夕法尼亚和新泽西的 11 座反应堆。

sentences.en: The work will not build anything new.
sentences.cn: 这项工程不会新建任何东西。

sentences.en: Instead it will raise the output of plants that are already running, adding about 890 megawatts to the grid, roughly what a new large reactor would supply.
sentences.cn: 它只是提高已经在运转的电厂的发电量,给电网增加约 890 兆瓦,差不多相当于一座新的大型反应堆的供应量。

sentences.en: The first upgrade is due in 2028, and the rest should be finished by 2032 or 2033.
sentences.cn: 第一个升级项目预计 2028 年完成,其余应在 2032 或 2033 年前完工。

sentences.en: Investors liked the news: shares in Constellation rose 12%, and other power producers climbed with it.
sentences.cn: 投资者认可这个消息:Constellation 股价上涨 12%,其他电力生产商也跟着上涨。

sentences.en: Technology firms are competing for electricity because a single data center can use as much as a small city, and nuclear plants run around the clock.
sentences.cn: 科技公司正在抢电,因为一座数据中心的用电量可能抵得上一座小城市,而核电厂是昼夜不停运转的。

notes: agree to buy ... for the next twenty years
签下未来二十年的购买合同。注意 for the next + 时间段,表示从现在往后数。
one of the largest deals yet
yet 放在最高级后面,意思是「到目前为止最大的之一」,比 so far 更简洁。
「根据协议」。新闻里介绍合同条款时的固定开头,也可说 under the terms of the deal。
spend + 金额 + doing,钱花在做某事上。不要写成 spend ... to upgrade。
raise the output of plants that are already running
提高现有机组的产量。业内把这种做法叫 uprate,新闻正文里会直接用这个词。
roughly what a new large reactor would supply
用 what 从句做比较基准,避免再写一遍 the amount of power that...。
跟着一起涨。with it 指前面提到的那只股票,省掉重复。
昼夜不停运转。around the clock 是地道说法,比 24 hours a day 更自然。

vocab.ex: The index closed at a record high for the third time this month.
vocab.exCn: 该指数本月第三次创收盘新高。
vocab.tip: 同义说法 all-time high。动词搭配:hit / set / close at a record high。

vocab.cn: 一段持续上涨的行情;回升
vocab.ex: The rally lost steam after the central bank raised rates.
vocab.exCn: 央行加息后,这波涨势失去了动力。
vocab.tip: 本义是「集合」,引申为价格一起往上冲。反面是 selloff(一波抛售)。

vocab.ex: The two companies signed a twenty-year power-purchase agreement.
vocab.exCn: 两家公司签了一份二十年购电协议。
vocab.tip: 新闻里常缩写成 PPA。买电的长期合同,买方锁定价格,卖方锁定买家。

vocab.ex: The upgrade will raise the plant's output by about a tenth.
vocab.exCn: 这次升级会让该厂发电量提高约十分之一。
vocab.tip: 重音在前。工厂讲 output,公司讲 production,经济体讲 GDP。

vocab.ex: The project adds 890 megawatts to the grid.
vocab.exCn: 该项目给电网增加 890 兆瓦。
vocab.tip: 原意是格子。送电线路织成网,所以叫 grid。off the grid = 不接电网、自给自足。

vocab.cn: 公司自己给出的业绩预期
vocab.ex: The company raised its full-year guidance after a strong quarter.
vocab.exCn: 在一个强劲的季度之后,公司上调了全年业绩预期。
vocab.tip: 是公司对自己未来的预测,不是分析师的。上调 raise / lift,下调 cut / lower。

vocab.ex: Earnings came in above consensus for the fourth straight quarter.
vocab.exCn: 利润连续第四个季度高于分析师平均预期。
vocab.tip: 原意「共识」。come in above / below consensus 是报财报的标准说法。

vocab.ex: The trade gap widened for a third straight month.
vocab.exCn: 贸易逆差连续第三个月扩大。
vocab.tip: 等同 trade deficit,但 gap 更短、更常上标题。扩大 widen,收窄 narrow。

vocab.ex: The seasonally adjusted figure fell 0.4% in August.
vocab.exCn: 经季节调整后的数字 8 月下降 0.4%。
vocab.tip: 把每年都会重复的淡旺季影响去掉,这样月与月之间才能比。

vocab.ex: Higher borrowing costs are a headwind for manufacturers.
vocab.exCn: 借钱成本上升对制造商是个阻力。
vocab.tip: 逆风。反义 tailwind(顺风、助力)。注意是可数名词,前面要加 a。

vocab.ex: The stock rose 6% in after-hours trading.
vocab.exCn: 该股在盘后交易中上涨 6%。
vocab.tip: 收盘之后的那一段。开盘前的那段叫 premarket trading。

vocab.ex: Strip out energy prices and inflation looks much milder.
vocab.exCn: 把能源价格剔除后,通胀看上去温和得多。
vocab.tip: 分析数据时的常用动作。同义 excluding / once you take out。

patterns.title: 涨跌的强度,用不同的动词分档
patterns.intro: 中文一个「涨」字管到底,英文要按幅度挑动词。挑错了,读者对数字大小的预期就错了。
rows: The index edged up 0.2% in quiet trading.
最中性,任何幅度都能用
Orders fell 10.6% from the month before.
Shares climbed for a fourth straight session.
明显的一下,通常 3% 以上
The stock jumped 12% after the deal was announced.
Memory sales surged 111% from a year earlier.
Gas prices soared to their highest level since 2022.

drill.q: 把这句译成英文:「该股在盘后交易中上涨 6%。」
drill.a: The stock rose 6% in after-hours trading.
drill.hint: 6% 不算大也不算小,用最中性的 rose 就好。

patterns.title: 业绩和预期,三组动词搭配
patterns.intro: 财报新闻几乎都在说同一件事:实际数字和事先的预期比,高了还是低了。记住这三组,一半的财报句子就能自己写。
rows: Penguin Solutions raised its revenue guidance to $2.43 billion.
The carmaker cut its full-year guidance for the second time.
Adjusted earnings of $2.87 a share topped the $2.62 analysts had expected.
Revenue missed expectations by a wide margin.
落在平均预期的上方/下方
Sales came in slightly below consensus.

drill.q: 填空:The company ____ its full-year revenue ____ to $2.4 billion, up ____ $2.1 billion.
drill.hint: 上调 + 公司自己的预期 + 「从……上调到……」。

patterns.title: 报一个经济数据,句子的骨架是固定的
patterns.intro: 指标 + 动词 + 幅度 + 时间范围 + 对比基准。五块按这个顺序排,写出来就是新闻腔。
rows: from the month before / from a month earlier
Factory orders fell 10.6% from the month before.
Memory sales more than doubled from a year earlier.
接在逗号后面补充背景
The gap widened to $106 billion, the highest since March 2025.
Orders have risen for a third straight month.
Orders fell 10.6%, compared with a 3.2% rise in July.

drill.q: 用这些要素造一句:贸易逆差 / 扩大到 1,060 亿美元 / 一年多来最大
drill.a: The trade gap widened to $106 billion, the widest in more than a year.
drill.hint: 先把主干写完,背景信息用逗号接在后面。

quiz.q: The index closed at a record ____ on Tuesday.
quiz.why: 固定搭配 record high(历史最高点)。tall 说的是物体的高度,top 要说 record top 不地道。

quiz.q: Higher borrowing costs are a ____ for manufacturers.
quiz.why: headwind 是逆风、阻力。tailwind 是助力,windfall 是意外之财。

quiz.q: Adjusted earnings of $2.87 a share ____ the $2.62 analysts had expected.
quiz.why: 超过预期用 beat / top / exceed。climbed 不能直接带这种宾语。

quiz.q: Orders fell 10.6% ____ the month before, compared ____ a 3.2% rise in July.
quiz.why: 环比用 from the month before;摆对照数用 compared with。

quiz.q: 把这句译成英文:「剔除几笔大额订单后,降幅只有 0.1%。」
quiz.a: Stripping out a few large orders, the decline was just 0.1%.
quiz.why: strip out 后面接被剔除的东西;「只有」用 just 或 only 都行。也可以写 Excluding a few large orders, ...
